answer: Answered in d-state-writer: the dispatching harness writes working/done/failed/blocked because it is the only party that knows the boundaries; the human may clear blocked on attach; nothing else writes. Staleness is bounded by the dispatcher's lifetime and by the fact that zmx's ended/exit_code is independent evidence, so a stale claim is visible rather than believed. Three values stay (working, blocked, done/failed), with only blocked carrying reader opinion.
body: Staleness, writer identity, and whether the reader may write.
title: Who writes state, when, and what does staleness cost?
